name: The_knights

tenures.source: Slammer profile cards for Chevalier, Justin_tyme and Rembrandt, all captured mid-2000 (see each character's own tenure source).
tenures.note: Named as Stable on three separate slammer profile cards (Chevalier, Justin_tyme, Rembrandt); Rembrandt's own card additionally calls him "one of the founding members of the Knights."

caption: A CyberSlam stable carrying Chevalier, Justin_tyme and Rembrandt across the CCW, CSlam and CFL, founded by Rembrandt's own account.

identity.note: Shares a decorated-aka substring with OWW's Night — a coincidental partial-word match, not a shared identity. CyberSlam's own Knights are a CyberSlam-original stable carrying Chevalier, Justin_tyme and Rembrandt.

name: Big_brother

tenures.source: Slammer profile cards for Al_bradd and Dr_douglas, captured 11 July 2000 and 16 May 2000 respectively.
tenures.note: Named as Stable on both Al_bradd's and Dr_douglas's own profile cards, which also bill each as the other's tag team partner.

caption: A two-man CBF/CFL stable pairing manager-psychiatrist Doctor Douglas with his own patient and tag partner Al_bradd, worshipped by both under the same name.

name: The_new_lead

tenures.source: Slammer profile cards for Hades and Psycohol, captured 8 July 2000 and 23 May 2000 respectively.
tenures.note: Named as Stable on both Hades's and Psycohol's own profile cards.

caption: A CBF stable carrying Hades and his sworn-enemy-adjacent, feuding CBF colleague Psycohol.

name: Xtasy

tenures.source: Slammer profile cards for Luciffer and Renegade, captured 1 June 2000 and 8 July 2000 respectively.
tenures.note: Luciffer's own card names his Stable "Xtasy" and calls him "the leader of X†ASY"; Renegade's own card, a different CBF-area fed (ICWA), closes with "Long live X†asy," the same stylized name.

caption: A CyberSlam stable — styled X†asy on its own members' cards — carrying self-billed leader Luciffer and his CWO tag partner Renegade into the ICWA.

identity.note: Shares a spelling variant with an existing registered "Extasy" — a coincidental stylized-spelling coincidence (both riff on "ecstasy"). CyberSlam's own Xtasy/X†asy is its own CWO/ICWA stable carrying Luciffer and Renegade.

name: House_of_pain

tenures.source: Slammer profile cards for Lord (captured 23 May 2000) and Bagelguy (captured 17 May 2000, prose evidence only).
tenures.note: Lord's own card names his Stable "House_of_pain" outright. Bagelguy's own card leaves its structured Stable field "None" but his own Introduction line bills him alongside "the entire House of Pain" — weaker, prose-only evidence for the second member, flagged as such.

caption: A CBF stable billed on Lord's own card and, more loosely, in Bagelguy's own introduction.

name: The Rat Pack

tenures.source: Named in Alisterfiend's own PreMatch Comments across two logged CWO matches: "Tag team title shot vs the Rat Pack(arcwing&purplehaze)for trecherous thursday." (/promotions/cyberslam/archive/cwo-match-121.html, /promotions/cyberslam/archive/cwo-match-122.html).
tenures.note: Alisterfiend faced both members as separate 1v1 legs of a CWO tag-title challenge, per the fed's own leg-by-leg match-logging convention; no partner of Alisterfiend's own is named on either leg.

caption: A CWO tag team pairing Arcwing and Purple_haze, named as the champions Alisterfiend challenged leg-by-leg for a tag team title shot at Treacherous Thursday.

identity.note: Shares a bare name with a registered unit The Rat Pack (the classic Sinatra-crew namesake, a common borrowing). CyberSlam's own Rat Pack is a CWO tag team of Arcwing and Purple_haze with no connection to the other unit on the record.

name: The_Crew

tenures.source: Edge's own Road to CWZ results, day one (/promotions/cyberslam/archive/news-1397-road-to-cwz-results.html).
tenures.note: "The_Crew regain the iMWA TAG TEAM TITLES" from Sickness 2K in a no-holds-barred cage match, Road to CWZ, 29 September 2000; a recurring named rival of iMWA's own World Champions per the newest champion's own interview.

caption: iMWA's own recurring tag team rival of the fed's World Champion of the day, who regained the iMWA Tag Team Championship from Sickness 2K in a cage match at Road to CWZ.

name: Sickness 2K

tenures.source: Edge's own Road to CWZ results, day one (/promotions/cyberslam/archive/news-1397-road-to-cwz-results.html).
tenures.note: Lost the iMWA Tag Team Championship to The_Crew in a no-holds-barred cage match at Road to CWZ, 29 September 2000, and "in the end split up" per the same report.

caption: The outgoing iMWA Tag Team Champions, dethroned by The_Crew in a cage match at Road to CWZ and reported split up in its own aftermath.
